tagline: Type a link or any text. A code appears. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Works offline, with no account: type a link, a phone number, a message, or a contact, and a code appears on this screen. Nothing is sent anywhere — the words never leave this device.

The last code you made comes back the next time you open the app, still inside this file. A shared link can open the app already filled in. Press Invite in the GifOS bar to put the same code on everyone else's screen in a meeting.

Unofficial port of qrcodejs by davidshimjs. A general maker — not only Wi-Fi. For a fridge card with the network name and password, use WiFi Card instead.
